about: Twelve questions, six per company: five the policies answer (expected document and line) and one they don't (abstain). Lines are line numbers in policies/<set>/<document>.md.

companies.harbor: Harbor Office Supply (org demo): discounts up to 15% without approval
companies.summit: Summit Workspace (org summit-demo): discounts up to 10% without approval
